ui_language.name: Interface language
ui_language.description: English or Czech. Separate from the manufacturer account language.

brand.name: Manufacturer app
brand.description: Use the brand where the cooker is registered.

country.name: Account country
country.description: Two-letter manufacturer market code. Keep the existing pairing region.

language.name: Account language
language.description: Two-letter manufacturer account language. Does not change the cooker firmware.

mqtt_host.name: MQTT broker
mqtt_host.description: Leave empty to discover the Home Assistant MQTT service.

mqtt_port.name: MQTT port
mqtt_port.description: Broker port, normally 1883 or 8883 for TLS.

mqtt_password.name: MQTT password
mqtt_password.description: Local broker password. Not the manufacturer account password.

mqtt_tls.name: MQTT TLS
mqtt_tls.description: Enable TLS when the broker supports it.
